purpose: Machine-readable sustainability and energy-efficiency profile for autonomous-agent decision making.
designIntent: Use the least computational and on-chain work reasonably necessary to complete an authorized action while preserving security, verifiability and reliability.

machineSelection.rule: Energy and environmental impact may be considered alongside security, cost, liquidity, reliability, jurisdiction and caller policy.

renewableEnergy.rule: Do not claim renewable or low-carbon operation without current, attributable evidence for the relevant infrastructure or service.

environmentalClaims.rule: Do not publish absolute environmental-superiority or per-transaction energy claims unless supported by appropriate current methodology and evidence.

humanValueStatement: 200 favors less unnecessary computation, fewer unnecessary transactions and efficient execution paths when these choices do not weaken security or correctness.
disclaimer: This profile describes sustainability design intent and machine-selection policy. It is not a carbon-neutrality certification, environmental rating, lifecycle assessment or guarantee of lower energy use than every alternative.
